name: Bonds to the End of Time

releases.name: Bonds to the End of Time

description.text: The second expansion of the DPt series, released on 26 December 2008. It brings the SP Pokémon of the Gym Leaders of Pokémon Platinum, marked GL, such as Luxray GL and Bastiodon GL, plus an Elite Four Alakazam, and many cards for SP Pokémon decks. The cards are numbered to 90, ending with new prints of the classic Pikachu, Surfing Pikachu and Flying Pikachu cards. In English it became Rising Rivals in May 2009.
